units.previous_finding: The mandatory zero value term remains English at its point of introduction. Source: Variables declared without an explicit initial value are given their _zero_value_. Candidate: Variabler som deklareres uten en eksplisitt startverdi, får sin _zero_value_. Present emphasis renders the visible English words zero value, which conflicts with the approved Bokmal nullverdi; revise the translatable visible term while preserving valid Present emphasis.

Minor technical terminology: source Test that a key is present with a two-value assignment; candidate Sjekk om en nøkkel finnes, ved hjelp av en tilordning med to returverdier. The map-index two-value assignment elem, ok = m[key] is not a function with two return values. Describe a two-value assignment without implying function return values; preserve the Go code.

B (naturalness), index 61 moretypes/25. English title: Function closures. Candidate title: Funksjons-closure-er. The Norwegian compound combines funksjons-, the English loanword closure and a mechanical -er plural, producing an awkward triple-part hyphenated heading; body also uses closure-er. Revise the inflection and compound naturally in Bokmal while preserving the approved closure terminology and the original explanation of captured variables.

B (Bokmal grammar), index 93 concurrency/1. English: The evaluation of f, x, y, and z happens in the current goroutine and the execution of f happens in the new goroutine. Candidate: Uttrykkene `f`, `x`, `y` og `z` evalueres i den nåværende goroutine, mens `f` kjøres i den nye goroutine. Both phrases with den require natural definite noun forms in Bokmal. Correct the two noun phrases while preserving the goroutine technical term and the current-versus-new goroutine execution distinction.
